title: Grok Imagine Video ---> Sprite Sheet for upgraded skill animations
author: BeltwayBro
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/i6jce7vd9gvh1.gif

Simple workflow that I'm guessing most of you are already using, but thought I would share JIC:

1. Take base art from my game that I used for basic sprite sheet generation
2. Animate the image via Grok imagine
3. Convert that video into a spreadsheet (There are a TON of tools our there but this one has become my go-to: [https://spritemaster.pages.dev/](https://spritemaster.pages.dev/) \- I'm pretty sure I found this on the sub)

Previously I was just using a single frame from my "block" sprite sheets. Small change but I feel like it personally takes this skill to the next level.

The question now is, should I attempt to have Grok create a similar video for every directional variant or would having it always be this one angle be good enough?
